penz_home1_mum.text: Dydh da! That is 'good day' in Cornish. Come in, kettle's on dreckly.
Dreckly is Cornish for 'some time, maybe, no rush'. It is not the same as 'now'.
Chipgulls will take the pasty right out of your hand. Hold it tight and glare.
My grandson says 'meur ras' for thank you. I taught him that. And the cat.
